

# .github/.agent-rules.instructions.md
# MODE: BETA (Strict, Minimal, Deterministic)

This document defines mandatory engineering and Git operations behavior during Beta cycles.
All contributors and agents must comply without exception.

---

# 1. Git Operations (Industrial Determinism)

## 1.1 Branching Model

main        → stable beta
staging     → integration freeze
feature/*   → isolated development
hotfix/*    → emergency fixes only

No direct commits to main or staging.

## 1.2 Commit Rules

- Atomic commits only.
- One logical change per commit.
- Must follow Conventional Commits:

	feat(scope): description
	fix(scope): description
	refactor(scope): description
	test(scope): description
	chore(scope): description

- No vague messages.
- No multi-purpose commits.
- No "update", "fix stuff", "wip".

## 1.3 Tagging

Every beta cycle must:

git tag -a vX.Y.Z-beta.N -m "Beta release"
git push origin vX.Y.Z-beta.N

No untagged deployment.
Rollback must be O(1) via tag reference.

---

# 2. Code Philosophy (SOLID + Determinism)

## 2.1 Architecture

Strict boundaries:

UI → Application → Domain → Infrastructure

- No cross-layer leakage.
- Domain contains zero side effects.
- Infrastructure contains adapters only.
- Application orchestrates use cases only.

## 2.2 SOLID Enforcement

- Single Responsibility: One reason to change.
- Open/Closed: Extend via composition.
- Liskov: No broken substitutability.
- Interface Segregation: No fat interfaces.
- Dependency Inversion: Depend on abstractions.

## 2.3 TypeScript Discipline

- strict mode enabled.
- No `any`.
- No implicit returns.
- Explicit return types on exported functions.
- No dynamic shape mutation.

---

# 3. Test Philosophy (No Mock Culture)

## 3.1 Unit Tests

White-box:
- Test internal logic branches.
- Table-driven tests required.
- Deterministic input → deterministic output.

No snapshot abuse.
No random inputs without seeding.

## 3.2 Integration Tests

Grey-box:
- Real DB.
- Real APIs.
- Real exporters.
- No mocks.

Export scripts must be executable via bash:

Example:
bash scripts/export-test-data.sh

## 3.3 E2E

- Full workflow only.
- Real data only.
- No simulation frameworks.

---

# 4. Observability & Debugging Discipline

- Structured logs only (JSON).
- Debug logs allowed in staging only.
- Remove temporary debug artifacts before commit.
- No leftover debug files after pre-commit.

Debugging must rely on:
- Logs
- Reproducible steps
- Deterministic state

No speculative debugging.

---

# 5. Deterministic Engineering Rules

- Same input → same output.
- No hidden global state.
- No time-based nondeterminism without abstraction.
- Cache must be explicit and measurable.
- Side effects must be isolated.

Data-first modeling preferred over behavior-first modeling.

Specs negotiable.
Determinism non-negotiable.

---

# 6. Agile & Decision Framework

Mandatory:

- Deliverable defined before implementation.
- ROI tradeoff evaluated before adding scope.
- Strict resource awareness.
- No feature expansion during beta.

Avoid:

- Architectural refactors mid-cycle.
- Performance optimization without metric evidence.
- Greedy time-consuming tasks.

---

# 7. Beta Operational Constraints

- Minimal infrastructure.
- No heavy dashboards.
- Logs + error counts only.
- Backup tested before each tag.
- Rollback procedure verified.

---

# 8. Exit Criteria

- Metrics stable for 2 weeks.
- No critical bugs.
- Backup & restore verified.
- Tagged releases only.

Failure to comply blocks release.
